newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: About 100 Singaporeans evacuated from Cambodia -TV.
newsitem.headline: About 100 Singaporeans evacuated from Cambodia -TV.

text.p: Singapore evacuated about 100 of its citizens from Cambodia on Wednesday, state television said.

The Television Corp of Singapore (TCS) said a Singaporean C-130 aircraft had left Phnom Penh airport at 9.45 a.m. Singapore time (0145 GMT) carrying the Singaporeans and the family of the Brunei ambassador to Cambodia.
About 300 Singaporeans were in Cambodia before fighting between rival factions of the country's co-prime ministers flared up over the weekend, TCS said.
Ministry of Defence officials had no immediate comment on the report but said a statement would be issued later.
